subject: Article: Representation Guidance, a pixel DiT that guides itself with its own bottleneck
body:
New flagship article on arXiv 2610.12978 (RG): the bottleneck and the
representation-shifted flow-matching target, its CFG-style fixed point,
and checks of the post's claims (plain blocks hold; "end-to-end" needs
DINOv2 REPA; 4x is in epochs, ~2-2.7x in compute; the FLUX.1-dev win is
GenEval/DPG and already held by MiniT2I without RG). Two interactives
(RG target toy, Table 2 FID board), five paper figures, charcoal
storyboard with host Lodestar.

subject: Add BudgetPix article: entropy-quadtree tokens for pixel diffusion
body:
Explains BudgetPix (arXiv 2610.12307): the entropy quadtree and budget
mode, the Patch Aggregator and Patch Refiner, the layout-augmented
fine-tune, and how the sampling-time layout is read off the model's own
x-hat after dense warm-up steps. Checks the "25% compute" claim (token
budget; ~27% of FLOPs and 3.59x on MiniT2I-L, 1.36x-1.95x elsewhere),
the MeanFlow 0.81 FID rise, and the human/VLM study against RTI.

Two widgets: an entropy quadtree on a procedural scene with per-block
FLOP ratios, and a warm-up ledger over the paper's Table 27. Five paper
figures and a calligraphy storyboard hosted by Quadra.
